_llm_instructions: Populate the fields of 'STAKEHOLDER ANALYSIS' and write the value of each field under 'Generated Value', based on the project context. Context: the project carrying reference PMO-03.05.

f01_ID.label: ID
f01_ID.guidance: Unique identifier linking back to the Stakeholder Register (e.g., SH-01).

f02_Name_or_Role.label: Name or Role
f02_Name_or_Role.guidance: The name or role of the stakeholder being analyzed.

f03_Interest.label: Interest
f03_Interest.guidance: The level of interest the stakeholder has in project outcomes (e.g., High, Medium, Low).

f04_Influence.label: Influence
f04_Influence.guidance: The level of power or influence the stakeholder has over the project (e.g., High, Medium, Low).

f05_Attitude.label: Attitude
f05_Attitude.guidance: The stakeholder's stance towards the project (e.g., Champion, Positive, Neutral, Negative).
